acceptance_criteria: `ct stats --json` prints a single JSON object parseable by json.loads and nothing else
the JSON object's total event count equals the count printed by `ct stats` without --json
`ct stats` without --json is byte-identical to the current output
intent: In ct/ct.py, give `ct stats` a `--json` flag. When present, cmd_stats prints exactly one JSON object (json.dumps, sort_keys=True) containing the same counts the plain text output reports (events, per event_type, edges/subjects as already computed), and prints nothing else. Without the flag the current text output must stay byte-identical. Add a unittest in tests/test_ct.py that builds a small ledger with the existing test helpers, runs the stats command with --json, parses stdout as JSON and asserts the event count and at least one event_type key. Keep the change minimal and stdlib-only; do not touch other commands. Return the complete new contents of ct/ct.py (whole file), changing only cmd_stats and its argparse registration; do not touch tests/test_ct.py in this candidate (the test is a separate follow-up).
